author: NorthEast News Desk
body: An agreement has been reached to reopen a well-used Walpole shortcut to Gillette Stadium with added safety changes, resolving an access dispute that had complicated event traffic near the Foxborough venue. The route passes through property associated with Rodman Ford and had been blocked by a tow truck during a recent surge of stadium-bound vehicles.

The shortcut has long offered some drivers an alternative connection between Walpole roads and the stadium corridor. Its closure pushed more vehicles toward established approaches and drew attention from residents, eventgoers and local officials. The new agreement is intended to restore access while addressing the concerns that led the property owner to restrict the route.

The arrangement does not replace official event-day traffic plans, and drivers should continue to follow police directions, posted signs and any temporary restrictions. Gillette Stadium’s schedule regularly brings concentrated traffic to the Walpole-Foxborough line, making small route changes significant for nearby neighborhoods. The reopening offers another option, but the promised safety adjustments will determine how the shortcut operates during the next major events.
dek: A route through a Walpole business property is expected to reopen under new safety conditions after access was blocked during stadium traffic.
headline: Safety agreement clears way to reopen Walpole shortcut to Gillette
